region_definitions.wall_samples: wall_measure > 0, bilinear cell-velocity sample at wall centroid

candidates.C0: UNIFORM_ALL_DOMAIN, exact production build_case negative control; no promotion
candidates.C1: STREAMFUNCTION_LOCALIZED_V0, exact current droplet_initial_state streamfunction u/v, case-specific x0/y0; solid velocity independently checked
candidates.C2: SDF_TAPERED_STREAMFUNCTION_V1, isolated diagnostic builder in this module; formula, taper and amplitude rule included in candidate details

C3.reason: C2 is evaluated first; optional constrained solve is prohibited unless C2 clearly fails a declared compatibility property

initializer_scale: one deterministic scalar per geometry, set by V_i-weighted phi>=0.9 core mean; no input-u-impact equality claim beyond this declared target.
phase_and_operator_freeze: C0/C1/C2 share bitwise phi, Solid geometry, M/eps/We/Re/cos_theta, phase transport, wetting, rho/nu, capillary force, eta_pen and all production operators; C2 changes only t=0 u/v.
physical_parameters_and_geometry: Derived per exact study_cases() from build_case, local _local_surface_top, actual SDF, case x0/R, and policy schedule. No shared y0 or geometry mutation.
return_flow_requirement: periodic localized downward motion requires a return flow; ambient/farfield and return-flow peak are reported separately.
